components.overview: Declarative option-group wrapper that turns child `<option>` nodes into generated radio or checkbox controls.

features.name: Supports `radio` and `checkbox` generation modes.
Keeps generated control state synchronized back to source options.
Observes child option mutations and re-renders automatically.
Optional visible group label with host styling hooks.
